promotion_gate: approved for the capped wrapper and unchanged runtime source/artifact hashes recorded here; correctness and adverse-workload performance gates passed

review.canonical_and_subgroup_validation: Every untrusted point still uses the strict subgroup decoder; only the complete canonical identity encoding is specialized.
review.pairing_grouping: Both operands of every original term decode in original order before any identity removal or equal-G2 grouping. Independent tests cover malformed neutral operands, nonadjacent repetitions, cancellation then resumption, cross-group cancellation, and 128-item batches.
review.proof_reuse: Only byte-identical key/proof pairs previously verified successfully within this same call are reused. Different proofs, invalid first/last proofs, identities and signature-domain substitutions remain rejected.
review.message_reuse: Ethereum repeated messages reuse only their deterministic same-call hash after proof validation; IC basic aggregation still requires exact-byte distinctness before crypto.
review.sorting: The bounded length-then-byte total-order merge sort agrees with an independent quadratic exact-equality oracle across threshold sizes, uneven runs, duplicates in all positions, empty/long common-prefix messages and deterministic generated inputs.
review.msm: Small Straus2/3 and signed Booth thresholds retain canonical scalar checks and original point-before-scalar error order. Independent full-width and carry fixtures agree with py_ecc expectations; integer reconstruction checks windows3/4/5/6 and byte/table/bucket bounds.
review.empty_operations: Empty MSM validates both batch lengths before returning the canonical identity; aggregate validates its packed batch before the shortcut.
review.secret_timing_contract: Scalar-dependent branches and table indexes are confined to documented public-scalar MSM. Single-scalar multiplication dispatch is unchanged. No secret constant-time claim is made for MSM.
review.abi: Compiler callbacks, dependencies and ABI are unchanged. Guarded tests retain unaligned output, input immutability, null empty inputs and unchanged output on error.
review.bounded_message_cache: The only functional wrapper change guards the existing equality scan with current message size <=1024. Longer messages skip all scans and follow the original hash path. Eligible comparisons inspect at most1024 bytes, bounding pairwise comparison work independently of caller message length. Native hashes remain identical; proof validation and error order are untouched.

limits: Functional and source audit, not formal verification or empirical side-channel proof.
Performance conclusions belong to the separate benchmark report.

wrapper_cap_reaudit.performance_gate: accepted; all adverse cases correct across3trials; <0.003% overhead on long distinct messages,7.506% instruction improvement on long repeated messages versus pre-round2
